pose: Macro TALL_MEASURE framing. This tiny, toothless pterosaur is perched upright on a vertical Ginkgo branch. Despite its small size, it fills the 1024px vertical span to allow for side-by-side height comparison. Its curved toes are wrapped around the bark, and its head is centered at the top safety margin.

environmental_details.ground: Grey-green tuffaceous sandstone visible in the far-focus bottom.
environmental_details.flora: Close-up detail of Ginkgo leaves; vibrant forest greens in the background.
environmental_details.atmosphere: Dappled sunlight filtering through a thick canopy.
